newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian chief minister escapes landmine blast.
newsitem.headline: Indian chief minister escapes landmine blast.

text.p: A landmine exploded in the northeastern Indian state of Assam on Sunday, minutes after state chief minister Prafulla Kumar Mahanta's convoy passed the spot, police said.
Police said the blast occurred at 1:05 p.m. (0735 GMT) in the centre of Guwahati, Assam's biggest city and its commercial capital.
City police chief K. Saikia said police were investigating. No group had claimed responsibility for the blast.
Several separatist groups, some tribal and others with Maoist ideologies, operate in northeastern India and accuse New Delhi of ignoring the region's economy.
